patterns.note: Asymmetrical two-column content blocks where a large image or visual element occupies one side, and text content scrolls independently on the other, creating a dynamic reading experience.
A dominant dark mode aesthetic for most content sections, contrasted with an initial light hero section, creating a strong visual transition upon scroll.
A sticky navigation bar that transforms from transparent and full-height to a smaller, dark-background version upon scrolling past the hero section.
A scroll-triggered sticky image column where a series of images remain fixed or slowly parallax on one side of the screen while associated text content scrolls past on the opposite side.
Large, bold sans-serif headings are used for section titles, providing strong hierarchy against lighter body text and occasional small uppercase labels.
Content sections are introduced with generous vertical padding and often feature a clear heading and a call to action, maintaining an airy and focused presentation.

technique_notes: The navigation bar is initially transparent and full-height, then uses a scroll-triggered event to apply a dark background and reduce its height, making it sticky to the top of the viewport.

A prominent visual effect involves a container of images that sticks to the viewport's right side, while a separate text container on the left scrolls normally, revealing different text content alongside the static images. This can be achieved with CSS position: sticky or JavaScript-driven parallax/pinning.
Content sections are revealed with a subtle fade-in or slide-up animation as they enter the user's viewport, enhancing engagement without being overly distracting.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized bold sans-serif headings (~3-4x body) with standard body text and occasional small uppercase labels.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle, with very slight rounding on buttons and card elements.
design_tokens.spacing: Airy hero section, balanced content sections with generous vertical rhythm between major blocks.

standout: The most distinctive element is the 'What we're making possible' section, which employs a sticky image column on one side while text scrolls independently on the other. This creates a highly engaging and dynamic storytelling experience that feels editorial and modern.
